arrive.text: You're a shepherd. After the storm, the ground has split open.

horse.text: Down in the crack, a hollow bronze horse. Inside it, a gold ring.

turn.text: Turn it inwards, and you vanish. Turn it back, and you're here again.

ask.text: Nobody can see you. Nobody would ever know. Would you still do what's right?

guards.text: The guards look straight through you.

treasury.text: The king's gold. Nobody is watching.

flock.text: Your sheep. If you vanished, they'd just carry on eating.

throw_clean.text: You drop the ring back into the dark. You never found out what you would have done with it.

throw_took.text: You drop the ring back into the dark. What you took, you keep. Nobody will ever know.

keep_clean.text: You keep the ring, and walk off into the hills. You haven't used it. Yet.

keep_took.text: You keep the ring, and walk off into the hills. You already know what you'd do with it.

king.text: Inside, the king, counting his gold. And the queen.

crown.text: His crown. He hasn't even noticed.

queen.text: In Plato's story, this is where the shepherd went next. With the queen's help, he killed the king, and took the throne.
